# vla-mcp full index

## Purpose

Orchestrate X Square open-weight VLA stack (Wall-OSS-0.5, WALL-WM, DMuon, X-VLA)
with the local MCP fleet (worldlabs-mcp, robotics-mcp, avatarops) for
event-grounded synthetic training, plus three persistent notebooks (personal
diary, AI-logged dev diary, aiwatcher news digest).

## MCP tools

### vla_status
Read-only snapshot of Wall-OSS, WALL-WM, DMuon, X-VLA health, HF weight cache,
dataset episode count.

### vla_pipeline_liveness
Stale VLA loops + unreachable fleet peers. Returns checks, alerts, healthy.
For supervisors (meta-mcp, fleet-agent, aiwatcher).

### vla_weights
Operations: list_models, local_status, download. Hugging Face checkpoint
manager for wall-oss-0.5, wall-wm, x-vla repos.

### vla_wall
Operations: health, infer_prepare, finetune_prepare, list_tasks, edge_prepare.
Wall-OSS-0.5 uses flow-matching action supervision for zero-shot manipulation.

### vla_xvla
Operations: health, list_targets, peft_config_template, peft_prepare,
edge_prepare, infer_prepare. X-VLA 0.9B PEFT adapter for edge agents.

### vla_world_model
Operations: health, train_prepare, predict_prepare, event_vocab.
WALL-WM couples Wan text-to-video prior with action DiT; event joints:
approaching, contact, lift, slide, recovery.

### vla_dataset
Operations: ingest_episode, segment_telemetry, list_episodes (paginated),
export_shard, export_numpy_shard, validate_multiview. JSON episodes + numpy
shards under VLA_DATASET_ROOT.

### vla_events
Operations: segment, vocab. Event-joint segmentation from telemetry rows.

### vla_training
Operations: health, co_train_prepare, config_template, introspect_train_args,
launch_co_train (confirm=True), job_status, job_log, stop_job.
DMuon distributed Muon optimizer for gradient-bridged co-training.

### vla_pipeline
Operations: describe, run, last_run. End-to-end fleet → ingest → numpy export
→ DMuon dry-run loop.

### vla_fleet
Operations: bridge_status, scenario_brief, list_peers, call_peer.
Default peers: worldlabs :10865, robotics :10706, avatar :10793, yahboom :10892.

### vla_world
Operations: describe, generate. 3D room generation via worldlabs-mcp
(returns Marble viewer URL).

### vla_diary
Three notebooks: personal (manual), dev (agent-logged), news (aiwatcher
digest). Operations: log (categories repo_fix, tool_install, blooper,
decision, note; author defaults to agent:opencode; tags use the repo:{name}
convention; optional metrics JSON), list, get, delete (confirm=True), news,
status (counts), summary (per-notebook count + latest entry). SQLite at
{VLA_DATASET_ROOT}/notebooks/notebooks.sqlite3, 500-entry cap per notebook.
REST mirror: /api/v1/notebooks.

### vla_agentic_workflow
SEP-1577 multi-step planning with optional ctx.sample.

### vla_help
Fleet integration, API keys, tools, configuration, troubleshooting docs.

## Webapp (ports 11024 backend / 11025 frontend)

Pages: Dashboard (KPIs + notebook cards), Dataset, Pipeline, Training,
Weights, Notebooks, Fleet, Tools, Help, Status.

REST API: /api/health, /api/v1/status, /api/v1/tools, /api/v1/fleet,
/api/v1/dataset/episodes, /api/v1/training/jobs[/{id}/log[/stream]],
/api/v1/pipeline/{last|run}, /api/v1/notebooks (+ entries, news digest),
/api/v1/help, /api/capabilities, /api/llm/* (aiwatcher bridge when mounted).

## Environment

VLA_WALL_X_ROOT, VLA_WALL_WM_ROOT, VLA_DMUON_ROOT, VLA_XVLA_ROOT,
VLA_XVLA_PEFT_ADAPTER, VLA_XVLA_PEFT_DIR, VLA_XVLA_EDGE_DEVICE, VLA_CHECKPOINT,
VLA_DATASET_ROOT, VLA_HF_CACHE_DIR, VLA_HF_WALL_OSS_REPO, VLA_HF_WALL_WM_REPO,
VLA_HF_XVLA_REPO, VLA_DEVICE, VLA_DMUON_VRAM_SHARDS, VLA_API_PORT,
VLA_FRONTEND_PORT, VLA_PREFAB_APPS, VLA_MOUNT_FLEET_PROXIES,
VLA_WORLDLABS_MCP_URL, VLA_WORLDLABS_GEN_TOOL, VLA_WORLDLABS_GEN_ARG,
VLA_YAHBOOM_MCP_URL, VLA_ROBOTICS_MCP_URL, VLA_AVATAR_MCP_URL,
VLA_MCP_BRIDGE_URLS, VLA_AIWATCHER_BASE_URL, VLA_AIWATCHER_API_KEY,
VLA_AIWATCHER_PUSH_ENABLED, VLA_PIPELINE_BOOMY_DEMO,
VLA_PIPELINE_GENERATE_WORLD, MCP_TRANSPORT.

News digest requires VLA_AIWATCHER_BASE_URL pointing at aiwatcher-mcp
(GET /api/items). Fleet event push uses the same host (POST /api/fleet/ingest).

## Run

uv sync --extra dev
uv run pytest tests -q
uv run uvicorn vla_mcp.server:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 11024
npm --prefix webapp run dev   # frontend :11025

## Architecture

webapp (Vite React) <-> REST :11024 <-> FastMCP server (vla_* tools)
  |-> aiwatcher :10946 (fleet events push + news digest pull)
  |-> worldlabs :10865, robotics :10706, avatar :10793 (peer bridge)
  |-> SQLite notebooks + JSON episode store under VLA_DATASET_ROOT
